title: Cheese Teleporter
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "CheeseTeleportGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

-- Делаем GUI крупным и заметным
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "MainFrame"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 140) -- Увеличил высоту для новой кнопки
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.5, -70)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
frame.BorderSizePixel = 3
frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
frame.Parent = gui

-- Делаем фон с эффектом свечения
local glow = Instance.new("UIGradient")
glow.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50))
})
glow.Rotation = 45
glow.Parent = frame

-- Заголовок
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "Title"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.2, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "🍕 CHEESE TELEPORT 🍕"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Parent = frame

-- Статус
local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Name = "Status"
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.15, 0)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.2, 0)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "Ready"
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
status.TextScaled = true
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.Parent = frame

-- Кнопка телепорта
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "TeleportButton"
button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.35, 0)
button.Text = "▶ TELEPORT ◀"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextScaled = true
button.BorderSizePixel = 2
button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.AutoButtonColor = true
button.Parent = frame

-- Кнопка Discord
local discordButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
discordButton.Name = "DiscordButton"
discordButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.25, 0)
discordButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.7, 0)
discordButton.Text = "💬 JOIN THE DISCORD"
discordButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242) -- Цвет Discord
discordButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
discordButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
discordButton.TextScaled = true
discordButton.BorderSizePixel = 2
discordButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
discordButton.AutoButtonColor = true
discordButton.Parent = frame

-- Анимация пульсации кнопки телепорта
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local pulseConnection

pulseConnection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if button and button.Parent then
        local pulse = math.sin(os.clock() * 3) * 0.1 + 1
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
            255,
            180 * pulse,
            0
        )
    else
        pulseConnection:Disconnect()
    end
end)

-- Делаем перетаскивание
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- Функция для копирования в буфер обмена
local function copyToClipboard(text)
    if setclipboard then
        setclipboard(text)
        return true
    elseif game:GetService("GuiService") and game:GetService("GuiService"):GetClipboard() then
        -- Альтернативный метод для некоторых исполнений
        game:GetService("GuiService"):SetClipboard(text)
        return true
    else
        return false
    end
end

-- Обработчик для кнопки Discord
discordButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local discordLink = "https://discord.gg/qR36JUm3qK"
    
    if copyToClipboard(discordLink) then
        status.Text = "✅ Discord link copied!"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
        discordButton.Text = "✅ COPIED!"
        
        task.wait(2)
        discordButton.Text = "💬 JOIN THE DISCORD"
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    else
        status.Text = "❌ Failed to copy!"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        
        -- Если копирование не удалось, показываем ссылку в статусе
        task.wait(1)
        status.Text = discordLink
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
        
        task.wait(3)
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end
end)

-- Основная логика
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function teleportTo(position)
    if character and character.Parent and humanoidRootPart then
        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    end
end

local function teleportPlayerTo(playerToTeleport, position)
    local char = playerToTeleport.Character
    if char and char.Parent then
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
        end
    end
end

-- Переменные
local isTeleporting = false
local antiCheeseLoop = nil
local bearDanceLoop = nil

-- Функция для проверки команды игрока
local function isPlayerInTeam(teamName)
    local team = game:GetService("Teams"):FindFirstChild(teamName)
    if not team then
        return false
    end
    return player.Team == team
end

-- Функция для получения всех игроков в команде
local function getPlayersInTeam(teamName)
    local team = game:GetService("Teams"):FindFirstChild(teamName)
    if not team then
        return {}
    end
    
    local players = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr.Team == team then
            table.insert(players, plr)
        end
    end
    return players
end

-- Функция для запуска анти-сырной механики
local function startAntiCheese()
    if antiCheeseLoop then
        antiCheeseLoop:Disconnect()
        antiCheeseLoop = nil
    end
    
    status.Text = "⚠️ NO CHEESE! FLYING!"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    
    antiCheeseLoop = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if isPlayerInTeam("Survivors") and character and character.Parent then
            local currentPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
            local upPosition = currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)
            teleportTo(upPosition)
        else
            if antiCheeseLoop then
                antiCheeseLoop:Disconnect()
                antiCheeseLoop = nil
                status.Text = "Ready"
                status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Функция для танца медведя
local function startBearDance()
    if bearDanceLoop then
        bearDanceLoop:Disconnect()
        bearDanceLoop = nil
    end
    
    -- Получаем всех игроков в команде Survivors
    local survivors = getPlayersInTeam("Survivors")
    if #survivors == 0 then
        status.Text = "No Survivors to teleport!"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
        return
    end
    
    -- Получаем позицию медведя (игрока в команде Bear)
    local bearPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
    
    -- Телепортируем всех выживших к медведю
    for _, survivor in ipairs(survivors) do
        teleportPlayerTo(survivor, bearPos)
    end
    
    status.Text = "🐻 TELEPORTED TO BEAR!"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    
    -- Сохраняем исходные позиции выживших
    local originalPositions = {}
    for _, survivor in ipairs(survivors) do
        local char = survivor.Character
        if char and char.Parent then
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                originalPositions[survivor] = root.Position
            end
        end
    end
    
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local duration = 10
    
    bearDanceLoop = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
        
        -- Проверяем, не вышел ли игрок из команды Bear
        if not isPlayerInTeam("Bear") then
            if bearDanceLoop then
                bearDanceLoop:Disconnect()
                bearDanceLoop = nil
                status.Text = "Ready"
                status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            end
            return
        end
        
        -- Проверяем время
        if elapsed >= duration then
            if bearDanceLoop then
                bearDanceLoop:Disconnect()
                bearDanceLoop = nil
                status.Text = "Ready"
                status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            end
            return
        end
        
        -- Двигаем выживших вперед-назад относительно их исходных позиций
        local step = math.sin(elapsed * 4) -- Быстрое движение вперед-назад
        
        for _, survivor in ipairs(survivors) do
            local char = survivor.Character
            if char and char.Parent then
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root then
                    local originalPos = originalPositions[survivor]
                    if originalPos then
                        -- Двигаем на 1 студ вперед и назад по оси Z
                        local newPos = originalPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, step * 1)
                        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isTeleporting then
        return
    end
    
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not map then
        warn("Map not found!")
        return
    end
    
    -- Проверяем команду игрока
    if isPlayerInTeam("Bear") then
        -- Игрок в команде Bear - телепортируем всех Survivors и запускаем танец
        startBearDance()
        return
    end
    
    -- Если игрок не в команде Survivors - выходим
    if not isPlayerInTeam("Survivors") then
        status.Text = "❌ Wrong team!"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        task.wait(2)
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
        return
    end
    
    -- Проверяем Cheese
    local cheeseAltar = map:FindFirstChild("CheeseAltar")
    if not cheeseAltar then
        warn("CheeseAltar not found!")
        return
    end
    
    local items = cheeseAltar:FindFirstChild("Items")
    if not items then
        warn("Items not found!")
        return
    end
    
    local item = items:FindFirstChild("Item")
    if not item then
        warn("Item not found!")
        return
    end
    
    local cheesePart = item:FindFirstChild("Cheese")
    
    -- Если Cheese нет - запускаем анти-сыр
    if not cheesePart or not cheesePart:IsA("BasePart") then
        warn("Cheese not found! Starting anti-cheese!")
        startAntiCheese()
        return
    end
    
    -- Если Cheese есть, но игрок в Survivors - телепортируем к сыру
    if isPlayerInTeam("Survivors") then
        -- Проверяем Detect
        local base = cheeseAltar:FindFirstChild("Base")
        if not base then
            warn("Base not found!")
            return
        end
        
        local detectPart = base:FindFirstChild("Detect")
        if not detectPart or not detectPart:IsA("BasePart") then
            warn("Detect not found!")
            return
        end
        
        isTeleporting = true
        button.Text = "⏳ TELEPORTING..."
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
        button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
        status.Text = "🔄 TELEPORTING..."
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
        
        local originalPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position
        
        teleportTo(cheesePart.Position)
        task.wait(1)
        
        teleportTo(detectPart.Position)
        task.wait(0.5)
        
        local belowPosition = detectPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        teleportTo(belowPosition)
        task.wait(0.5)
        
        teleportTo(originalPosition)
        
        isTeleporting = false
        button.Text = "▶ TELEPORT ◀"
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
        button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        status.Text = "✅ Teleport complete!"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
        
        task.wait(1.5)
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end
end)

-- Обработка перезагрузки персонажа
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    character = newCharacter
    humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end)

-- Обработка смены команды
player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
    if antiCheeseLoop then
        antiCheeseLoop:Disconnect()
        antiCheeseLoop = nil
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end
    
    if bearDanceLoop then
        bearDanceLoop:Disconnect()
        bearDanceLoop = nil
        status.Text = "Ready"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end
end)
features:
making cheese altar puzzle and also if you are bear it teleports players to you
PLS JOIN DISCORD
